job.title: Data Scientist, Enterprise Analytics
job.pay_full: $86,400 – $176,400 a year base salary (US range for the listed level); bonuses, equity and benefits not included

details.about: GitLab is an orchestration platform for DevSecOps, trusted by more than 50 million registered users and more than half of the Fortune 100. On the Enterprise Analytics team, this Data Scientist is a trusted analytical partner to Sales, Revenue Operations and Finance: applying statistics, experimentation and machine learning to forecast outcomes, explain what drives activation, conversion, expansion and retention, size opportunities, and support the company-level go-to-market reporting executives use, covering consumption, ARR and first orders.
duties: Embed with business teams as a trusted partner for insights and strategic decisions across go-to-market
Run exploratory analysis to find trends and the key drivers of business performance, and explain them to non-technical audiences
Build and productionize machine learning models such as propensity, product-qualified lead scoring, churn and expansion, using MLOps practices
Design, run and evaluate growth experiments (A/B tests and quasi-experiments) on onboarding, pricing and packaging, and upgrade flows
Build agentic workflows for analysis, modeling and pipeline automation, with evaluation and monitoring that keep results accurate and traceable
Contribute to GitLab's Semantic Layer so stakeholders can self-serve trusted metrics
Write production-grade Python and SQL and uphold those standards through code review
needs: 3–5 years of professional experience in go-to-market analytics, data science or a similar technical role
Ability to turn ambiguous business problems into measurable questions and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Experience with experimentation and causal inference (A/B testing, power analysis, quasi-experimental methods) and with regression, classification, clustering and survival analysis
Deep, hands-on SQL in cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, including product usage and event data, and BI tools such as Looker, Tableau or Hex
Python for statistical modeling and production data science, with pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Jupyter, LightGBM and XGBoost
Hands-on experience building agentic workflows with coding agents, connecting them to tools such as MLflow and checking their output for accuracy
Experience in a B2C company working with motions and metrics such as consumption, CRR, ARR, and churn and contraction
Self-motivated and organized, able to use GitLab and thrive in a fully remote company
details.benefits: US base salary range $86,400 – $176,400 a year for the listed level; the level and salary are set through interviews and a review of experience and other factors, and the range excludes bonuses, equity and benefits. GitLab supports full-time employees with benefits for health, finances and well-being, flexible paid time off, team member resource groups, equity compensation and an employee stock purchase plan, a growth and development fund, and parental leave.
notes: Fully remote role in the United States
GitLab welcomes candidates who don't meet every single requirement
